description: Confirmed fiducial configuration for the A=16 catalogue parity-violation study.
document_type: Configuration summary; run_configuration contains the original submission settings.

run_configuration.description: Fresh confirmation of the best tested configuration: A=16, fixed shape cut, 50 new independent Gaussian ICs, three matched helicities.

displacement.normalization: A^2 = ensemble expectation of the spatial mean of |Psi_hel|^2; individual realizations are not rescaled.
displacement.helical_power_shape: P_delta(k) * exp(-(k * R_h)^2) / k^4 on active Fourier modes
displacement.mode_normalization: W_k = helical_power_shape(k) / sum_active_modes(helical_power_shape); displacement power = A^2 * W_k
displacement.helicity_mixture: Psi_hel = A * [sqrt((1 + epsilon)/2) * u_plus + sqrt((1 - epsilon)/2) * u_minus]
displacement.unit_fields: Independent pure-helicity Gaussian vector fields u_plus and u_minus, each with ensemble RMS magnitude 1.
displacement.particle_load: Regular cell-centred lattice; both displacement fields evaluated at the same Lagrangian q using NUFFT.

realizations.random_streams: SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3): density, positive helicity, negative helicity.
realizations.matching: Independent Gaussian density and independent helical pair for each seed; the three helicities share that density, lattice and helical pair within a seed.

estimator.triangulation: Periodic Delaunay tetrahedra using the frozen DIVE executable.
estimator.vertex_order: Ascending sum of squared distances from each vertex to the other three; first vertex is the reference.
estimator.chi_hat_definition: dot(v1, cross(v2, v3)) / (norm(v1) * norm(v2) * norm(v3)); edge vectors follow the canonical vertex order.
estimator.catalogue_signal: S_s,B(epsilon) = mean chi_hat over selected tetrahedra B in realization s.

selection.label: Shape third 2
selection.ratio_definition: r = l_min / l_max using the three reference-vertex edges.

selection_origin.chosen_group: Middle third of the reference r distribution.
selection_origin.ranking: Largest absolute paired Student t among nine cuts; baseline excluded.

analysis.primary_test: One frozen amplitude and shape cut; two-sided paired Student t at alpha=0.05, requiring the discovery sign. D_s = S_s(+1) - S_s(-1).
analysis.secondary_controls: Unselected tetrahedra, epsilon=0 and ZA-only controls are descriptive.
analysis.stopping_rule: Analyze all 50 new ICs without adapting A, the cut, or sample size.
analysis.uncertainty: Sample standard deviation of matched differences divided by sqrt(50); 95% mean confidence interval uses Student t with 49 degrees of freedom.
analysis.histogram: One catalogue-mean chi_hat per IC and helicity; probability density normalized separately. Gaussian curves use the sample mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1), not SEM.

gaussian_parameter_estimates.mu: sample mean of the 50 catalogue signals

analysis.amplitude_choice: Best selected |mean D|/SEM in the completed amplitude scan; fixed before these ICs.

scope: Confirms the catalogue response at the chosen configuration; does not test a continuous amplitude optimum, Gaussianity, cosmological calibration or numerical convergence.
